subtitle: Kota Rani and the last stand of the old Kashmir court

panels.shot: epic low-angle mid-shot against the Kashmir valley and fort walls
panels.action: Kota Rani stands on a stone rampart above the Jhelum, snow peaks behind her and dark clouds gathering, her face calm but watchful, hand resting on the parapet as if feeling the land beneath.

dialogue.text: In a valley shaken by kings and courtiers, Kota Rani rose as regent, ruled as queen, and watched as Shah Mir slowly closed his net around the last Hindu throne of Kashmir.

i18n.hi: जब राजा और दरबारी वादी को हिला रहे थे, कोटा रानी रीजेंट बनी, रानी की तरह राज किया, और देखती रही कैसे शाह मीर धीरे-धीरे कश्मीर के आख़िरी हिंदू सिंहासन को घेरता गया।

panels.shot: slow push-in from wide valley to close on royal balcony
panels.action: From a palace balcony above Srinagar’s clustered roofs and the winding Jhelum, Kota Rani looks out over the misty city at dawn, her expression alert, a scroll of accounts resting beside her.

dialogue.text: When Udayanadeva wore the crown but could not hold the kingdom, it was Kota Rani who kept the council together, the revenues flowing, and the valley’s fragile peace from breaking.

i18n.hi: जब उदयनदेव ने मुकुट तो पहन लिया पर राज संभाल नहीं पाए, तब कोटा रानी ने ही सभा को जोड़े रखा, ख़ज़ाना चलता रखा और वादी की नाज़ुक शांति टूटने से बचाई।

panels.shot: medium interior shot of court hall, queen seated slightly forward from king’s throne
panels.action: In a carved wooden hall lit by oil lamps, the pale, distracted figure of Udayanadeva sits on the central throne while Kota Rani, slightly ahead and to the side, speaks to gathered nobles and scribes.

dialogue.text: Jonaraja calls Udayanadeva weak. Petty chiefs rose in the hills, revenue men cheated in the plains, and whispers in the hall said the king listened little and acted less.

i18n.hi: जोनराजा उदयनदेव को कमजोर कहता है। पहाड़ियों में छोटे सरदार उठ खड़े हुए, मैदानी वसूलीवाले cheated, और दरबार में फुसफुसाहट थी कि राजा कम सुनता, और उससे भी कम करता।

panels.shot: over-the-shoulder shot from behind Kota Rani toward a group of Brahmin officials
panels.action: Kota Rani, composed yet firm, addresses a cluster of Brahmin scholars and clerks seated on low cushions, palm-leaf manuscripts stacked around them in an austere chamber.

dialogue.text: To steady the court, she turned to learning and order. She raised the Brahmin Bhatta Bhikshana as her chief minister, trusting his pen and mind to bind the kingdom where swords failed.

i18n.hi: दरबार को संभालने के लिए उसने विद्या और अनुशासन का सहारा लिया। उसने ब्राह्मण भट्टा भिक्षण को प्रधान मंत्री बनाया, भरोसा किया कि उसकी कलम और बुद्धि वहां राज जोड़ेगी जहां तलवारें चूक गईं।

panels.shot: wide bird’s-eye of Srinagar with river, bridges, and fort of Andarkot in mid-distance
panels.action: From above, the viewer sees the Jhelum snaking through Srinagar, wooden houses crowding its banks and, further along, the solid outline of Andarkot fort rising over the water.

dialogue.text: Kota Rani shifted power toward Andarkot on the river, a new stronghold near Srinagar. It was both fortress and signal: the regent would not be only a figure behind a frail king.

i18n.hi: कोटा रानी ने ताकत नदी किनारे अंदरकोट की ओर मोड़ी, श्रीनगर के पास नया गढ़ बनाया। वो किला भी था और इशारा भी: रीजेंट सिर्फ़ कमजोर राजा के पीछे की परछाईं नहीं रहेगी।

panels.shot: interior strategy table shot, medium, with Kota Rani leaning over a map
panels.action: Kota Rani stands over a low table spread with rough maps of the valley, pebbles marking forts and passes, while a few officers and scribes look on, awaiting her instruction.

dialogue.text: She handled petitions, watched discontented hill chiefs, and tried to keep the routes open for traders and pilgrims. The chronicler shows a woman acting where the king hesitated.

i18n.hi: वो फरियादें सुनती, नाखुश पहाड़ी सरदारों पर नज़र रखती, और व्यापारियों-तीर्थयात्रियों की राहें खुली रखने की कोशिश करती। इतिहासकार एक ऐसी स्त्री दिखाता है जो वहां काम करती है जहां राजा झिझकता है।

panels.shot: intimate palace chamber shot, mid-close, Kota Rani in half-shadow beside Udayanadeva’s empty bed
panels.action: In a quiet inner room, Udayanadeva’s bed and insignia stand unattended while Kota Rani, in half-shadow, sits on a low seat, eyes lowered in thought beside a dim lamp.

dialogue.text: Then everything changed. Udayanadeva died, leaving sons too young to rule and a valley where old loyalties were thin and new ambitions were bold.

i18n.hi: फिर सब बदल गया। उदयनदेव मर गया, पीछे ऐसे बेटे छोड़कर जो राज के लायक नहीं थे, और एक वादी जहां पुरानी वफादारियाँ पतली थीं और नई महत्वाकांक्षाएँ मोटी।

panels.shot: ceremonial hall wide shot, with child prince in background and Kota Rani in foreground
panels.action: In the same hall, a small boy wearing a coronet is guided to a seat by attendants, while Kota Rani stands before a line of nobles, her voice raised in calm authority.

dialogue.speaker: kota_rani
dialogue.text: The king is a child. The kingdom is not. We will govern with one mind.

i18n.hi: राजा तो बच्चा है। राज्य नहीं। हम एक ही सोच से राज चलाएँगे।

panels.shot: medium shot of Kota Rani and Bhikshana in council, side view
panels.action: At a long bench, Kota Rani confers closely with her minister, a dignified Brahmin with greying hair, while behind them other councillors murmur, some faces wary, some resentful.

dialogue.text: With Bhikshana beside her, Kota Rani ruled as regent. Jonaraja notes her appointments and orders; the queen and her minister now stood between the child throne and the restless chiefs.

i18n.hi: भिक्षण को साथ लेकर कोटा रानी ने रीजेंट की तरह राज किया। जोनराजा उसकी नियुक्तियाँ और आदेश लिखता है; रानी और उसका मंत्री अब बच्चे सिंहासन और बेक़रार सरदारों के बीच दीवार बनकर खड़े थे।

panels.shot: shadowed corridor shot, low-angle, with a cloaked figure slipping past carved pillars
panels.action: In a dim palace corridor lined with painted pillars, a shadowed figure moves quickly, glancing around before disappearing through a small side door, suggesting hidden meetings.

dialogue.text: Beyond the official court, another power watched. Shah Mir, a foreign adventurer who had risen in Kashmir, waited and listened as the old dynasty strained under its own weight.

i18n.hi: दरबार की हद से बाहर एक और ताकत देख रही थी। शाह मीर, एक बाहरी मुहिमबाज़ जो कश्मीर में उभर चुका था, चुपचाप देखता-सुनता रहा जबकि पुरानी वंश खुद के बोझ तले चरमरा रही थी।

panels.shot: wide shot of Andarkot ramparts with mixed troops drilling below
panels.action: On the grounds below Andarkot’s stone walls, troops with varied dress and banners practice maneuvers as Kota Rani observes from the rampart, arms folded, her gaze measuring their loyalty.

dialogue.text: Kota Rani could see Shah Mir’s influence growing among soldiers and nobles. She strengthened Andarkot and tightened her circle, but every move also revealed who stood with her and who did not.

i18n.hi: कोटा रानी देख रही थी कि सैनिकों और अमीरों में शाह मीर का असर कैसे बढ़ रहा है। उसने अंदरकोट को मज़बूत किया, अपना घेरा कसा, पर उसके हर कदम से ये भी साफ़ होता गया कि कौन उसके साथ है और कौन नहीं।

panels.shot: tense council chamber close, focusing on Bhikshana’s face as he speaks and Kota Rani listens
panels.action: In a packed council room, Bhikshana leans forward to argue a point, lines of concern on his face, while Kota Rani listens intently, her jaw set, as rival courtiers sit stiffly around them.

dialogue.text: Her trust in Bhikshana angered rivals. The minister’s authority over revenue and appointments made enemies among nobles who saw their own influence shrinking.

i18n.hi: भिक्षण पर उसका भरोसा, बिरोधियों को खलने लगा। राजस्व और नियुक्तियों पर मंत्री की पकड़ से उन अमीरों में दुश्मनी जागी जिन्हें अपना असर घटता दिख रहा था।

panels.shot: dramatic interior shot of palace courtyard at night, with commotion around fallen minister
panels.action: In a torch-lit palace courtyard at night, servants and guards cluster in shock around a still figure on the ground, while Kota Rani stands at the archway, hand to the wall, eyes wide and stricken.

dialogue.text: Jonaraja tells of Bhikshana’s murder. The chief minister was slain in conspiracy, and with his fall the queen lost the man who could turn her will into law.

i18n.hi: जोनराजा भिक्षण की हत्या का ज़िक्र करता है। प्रधान मंत्री साज़िश में मारा गया, और उसके गिरने के साथ रानी ने वो आदमी खो दिया जो उसकी मर्ज़ी को क़ानून बना सकता था।

panels.shot: close-up on Kota Rani’s face, lit by a single lamp, resolve hardening
panels.action: In a small chamber, Kota Rani sits alone before a single burning lamp, her gaze sharp, tears unshed, fingers tightening around the arm of her chair.

dialogue.text: Bhikshana’s death was a turning point. Kota Rani still held the title and the fort, but the machinery of rule was broken, and other hands began to reach for it.

i18n.hi: भिक्षण की मौत मोड़ साबित हुई। कोटा रानी के पास अब भी पद और किला था, पर राज चलाने की मशीन टूट चुकी थी, और उसे पकड़ने के लिए दूसरी हाथ आगे बढ़ने लगे।

panels.shot: wide shot of royal courtyard with armed nobles withdrawing, seen from Kota Rani’s perspective
panels.action: From the palace steps, Kota Rani watches as a group of armoured chiefs ride out of the courtyard, their faces closed, standards lowered, leaving her and a smaller guard behind.

dialogue.text: Jonaraja describes chiefs and soldiers deserting her cause. As alliances shifted toward Shah Mir, the queen’s orders carried less weight in barracks and border forts.

i18n.hi: जोनराजा सरदारों और सैनिकों के उसके साथ से हटने की बात लिखता है। जैसे-जैसे गठजोड़ शाह मीर की ओर मुड़े, रानी के आदेशों का वज़न छावनियों और सरहदी किलों में हल्का पड़ता गया।

panels.shot: dynamic shot of Andarkot under looming siege, seen from outside walls
panels.action: From outside Andarkot, the stone walls rise stubbornly while distant lines of troops assemble on the surrounding ground, banners fluttering, the sky heavy with low clouds.

dialogue.text: In later Persian and Kashmiri tradition, Andarkot became the stage of her last stand. Kota Rani is remembered resisting until her refuge itself was hemmed in and her supporters thinned.

i18n.hi: बाद की फ़ारसी और कश्मीरी परंपरा में अंदरकोट को उसकी आख़िरी जंग का मैदान बताया गया। कोटा रानी को याद किया जाता है, लड़ती रही जब तक उसका आसरा ही घिर गया और उसके साथी छिटकते गए।

panels.shot: somber palace interior shot, Kota Rani facing emissaries in rich but unfamiliar dress
panels.action: In a subdued hall, Kota Rani stands tall but pale before emissaries in fine robes, their manner confident, as a small group of her remaining attendants look on anxiously.

dialogue.text: By 1339, Shah Mir’s position was strong enough to claim the throne. Sources speak of pressure, arrangements, and confinement; Kota Rani’s power ended not in open battle, but in closed negotiation and defeat.

i18n.hi: १३३९ तक शाह मीर इतना ताकतवर हो चुका था कि सिंहासन पर दावा कर सके। स्रोतों में दबाव, सौदे और नजरबंदी का ज़िक्र है; कोटा रानी की ताकत खुली जंग में नहीं, बंद बातचीत और हार में खत्म हुई।

panels.shot: quiet prison-like chamber shot, Kota Rani seated behind lattice, distant sounds outside
panels.action: In a bare room with a wooden lattice window, Kota Rani sits in simple clothes, her posture still dignified, listening to faint echoes of activity outside that she no longer directs.

dialogue.text: Jonaraja’s account suggests she died after Shah Mir took power, perhaps in confinement. Later tales of hairpin suicide add drama, but the core truth is simpler and harsher: the last queen was pushed aside.

i18n.hi: जोनराजा की कहानी इशारा करती है कि शाह मीर के राज संभालने के बाद वो मरी, शायद कैद में। बाद की हेयरपिन से आत्महत्या वाली कथाएँ रंग भरती हैं, पर सच्चाई ज़्यादा सीधी और कड़ी है: आख़िरी रानी को किनारे कर दिया गया।

panels.shot: wide contemplative shot of Srinagar and the valley at dusk, camera floating high above
panels.action: At dusk, the valley lies under a soft blue haze, Srinagar’s roofs clustering along the river, the silhouette of Andarkot barely visible, as if half-remembered in the fading light.

dialogue.text: Kota Rani’s story is of a ruler who could think, plan and endure, yet lost the valley when her allies fell away. Her end asks, even now: how much can courage do, standing alone against a shifting court?

i18n.hi: कोटा रानी की दास्तान एक ऐसे शासक की है जो सोच सकती थी, योजना बना सकती थी, सह सकती थी, फिर भी साथियों के हटते ही वादी खो बैठी। उसका अंत आज भी पूछता है: अकेला साहस कितना कर सकता है, एक बदलते दरबार के सामने?

subtitle_i18n.en: Kota Rani and the last stand of the old Kashmir court
subtitle_i18n.hi: कोटा रानी और पुराने दरबार की आख़िरी लड़ाई
